comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @bobylito, @Morhaus and @vvo to be potential reviewers
I don't think we should change the defaults because when searching it might make the selected disappears, which is very confusing for users.

> when searching it might make the selected disappears, which is very confusing for users

Do you mean when refining the search again in the searchbox, they might disappear? I think I see what you mean but could you precise a bit more the steps and causes that would lead to that bad behavior?

> could you precise a bit more the steps and causes that would lead to that bad behavior?

Yes sure. Here you can't see epiphone in the list of brands http://feigned-queen.surge.sh/?query=&hits=24&idx=instant_search&p=0&dFR%5Bbrand%5D%5B0%5D=Epiphone&is_v=1

As seen in the provided example, the facet disappears when sort is only count + alpha, cc @Kikobeats.

There's no silver bullet for now, @bobylito wants to review all options we have and if we need to make changes to the default sort we do.

title: feat(widget): change default sortBy of refinementList to [count:desc, name:asc]
